N.B. - This Extraordinary Gazette is printed in Sinhala, Tamil and English Languages seperately.
THE PARLIAMENTARY ELECTIONS ACT, No. 1 OF 1981
General Election to elect Members of the Parliament
NOTICE is hereby given under Section 24(1) (b) and (d) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981 that –

(I) the order in which the name of each recongnized Political Party and the distinguishing number of each Independent Group and the symbol allotted to each such Party or Group appearing in the ballot paper of each such Electoral District shall be in the same order as given in the Schedule hereto; and the names of candidates (as indicated by the candidates) of each recognized Political Party or Independent Group, placed in alphabetical order in accordance with the Sinhala alphabet, nominated for election as Members of Parliament from each such Electoral District and the preferential number assigned to each candidate, are as specified in the Schedule hereto ;

(II) the situation of the polling station or stations for each of the polling districts in each such Electoral District, and the particular polling stations reserved for female voters, if any, are as specified in the Schedule hereto.
R. M. A. L. Rathnayake, M. A. P. C. Perera, Ameer Faaiz, Chairman, Member, Member, Election Commission. Election Commission. Election Commission.
A. Shanmuganathan, Prof. Lakshman Dissanayake, Member, Member, Election Commission. Election Commission.
